items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Frankie Clarice Trombone and quite a few. Johnny had a very good band

ctx.x: Yeah, he was there, because Jack Teagarden, him and Jack was good buddies, formed a good friendship. And Jack just come out of there, leave Ben Pollack's Pollard's band (unintelligible) down around town. All of them come uptown, Tommy Dorsey, Jack Teagarden, Frank -- Frankie Clarice Trombone and quite a few. Johnny had a very good band -- oh, Sidney DeParis came in after Tommy left, Sidney DeParis.
